Amplitude is hiring a Head of Global Total Rewards, reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), to own our compensation programs and global benefits portfolio. Amplitude is a leading digital analytics platform that helps companies understand how customers use their products and act on those insights, and our People team attracts, rewards, and retains the talent that builds it. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with regular partnership with the CEO, CFO, General Counsel, and other executives, serving as a trusted advisor to the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors. You’ll design and run a total rewards strategy that is competitive, financially disciplined, legally sound, and fair, while ensuring employees around the world understand and value our programs.

As a Head of Global Total Rewards, you will:

  • Own global compensation strategy and programs: Set and evolve our compensation philosophy, pay structures, salary bands, leveling, and job architecture, using market benchmarking to keep programs current across geographies. Design and administer equity programs, including RSUs, stock options, ESPP, and new-hire and retention grants, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and our equity plan administrator. Advise on offers and retention situations, own pay equity analysis and remediation, and ensure compliance with applicable compensation regulations.

  • Lead compensation planning and employee enablement: Own annual and midyear compensation cycles, including manager training, compensation planning tools in partnership with People Systems, and budget alignment with Finance. Partner closely with People Business Partners to support business needs and effective global administration, and drive employee communications that build transparency and understanding of our total rewards programs.

  • Partner with executives and the Compensation Committee: Serve as the primary People team contact for Committee materials, preparing analyses, recommendations, and decks and supporting the CHRO in presenting them. Lead executive and director compensation recommendations, peer-group selection, pay-for-performance analysis, and equity burn and dilution modeling. Partner with Finance on compensation budgets, headcount cost forecasting, equity expense, and share pool planning, and with Legal on proxy and SEC disclosure inputs, plan documents, and governance requirements.

  • Lead global benefits end to end: Own the strategy, design, vendor management, and delivery of health and wellness, retirement and savings, leave and time off, mental health and family support, and perks. Lead renewals and open enrollment, including broker and carrier selection, financial modeling, funding strategy, and contract negotiation. Oversee administration, vendor performance, data integrity, employee support, and compliance with ERISA, ACA, COBRA, 401(k), and local statutory requirements. Use utilization, cost trends, and employee feedback to improve value and control costs, and drive retirement plan committee requirements and quarterly meetings.

  • Build and run the Total Rewards function: Lead and develop the team, manage external partners and advisors, and establish clear processes, controls, and audit-ready documentation across compensation and benefits. Translate complex data into clear recommendations for executive and Board decisions, and serve as a thought partner to the CHRO on workforce planning, retention, and the overall employee value proposition.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • Experience connecting sales compensation to business performance: You’ve partnered with Sales and Finance in a SaaS go-to-market organization and understand how incentive design can support revenue goals, reinforce the right behaviors, and align with the broader compensation philosophy.

  • Experience scaling Total Rewards after an IPO: You’ve helped programs evolve with the demands of a public company, strengthening compensation practices, equity planning, governance, and controls while keeping programs practical for managers and meaningful to employees.

  • Experience guiding rewards programs through growth and change: You’ve supported international expansion or M&A integration, navigating differences in compensation structures, benefits offerings, and local requirements. You bring thoughtful judgment about where global consistency adds value and where local flexibility is needed.

  • Strong systems and analytical capabilities: You’re proficient with HRIS and compensation planning tools, such as Workday, and bring advanced Excel or SQL skills. You know how to turn complex data into useful insights, improve planning and administration, and make recommendations that leaders can confidently act on.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You bring 12+ years of progressive Total Rewards experience, including 5+ years leading a team, ideally at a high-growth, publicly traded software or technology company. You’ve demonstrated the ability to develop teams, drive change, and balance rigor with speed.

  • You have deep expertise in compensation design, equity programs, and executive compensation, including direct experience preparing materials for and presenting to a Compensation Committee. You can advise executives and Board members, handle confidential matters with discretion, and push back with data when needed.

  • You have hands-on experience running global benefits programs across the US and international markets, including broker, carrier, and vendor management.

  • You bring strong financial and analytical skills, including building cost models, equity burn and dilution analyses, and budget forecasts, and explaining your recommendations to a CFO.

  • You have working knowledge of US and international compensation and benefits regulations, public company governance, and SEC disclosure requirements.

Job Summary

Responsibilities

About the role

The PX Content team organizes and maintains knowledge about our product, from feature documentation to business use cases that help clients use Bloomreach independently. Our documentation is the single source of truth for clients, partners, prospects, and internal teams. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Support, Client Services, and Sales in a multinational environment.

You don’t need to know our platform or the ecommerce world on day one. Curiosity and good writing instincts matter most, and you’ll build the rest with the team.

What you'll do

  • Make APIs easy to use: Create and maintain clear documentation for features and guides, with API documentation at the core: references, integration guides, code examples, and release notes. Work from OpenAPI specs and try calls yourself, so the docs reflect how the product really behaves.
  • Walk in the user’s shoes: Run through API setup and integration flows, anticipate users’ questions, and spot where docs, error messages, or naming could make a user’s life easier.
  • Write for people and machines: Create documentation that works for a developer mid-integration and for the AI assistants and search tools that retrieve it. Our AI writing assistant is there to help.
  • Work like our developers do: Author in Markdown and use GitHub pull requests for reviews and publishing.
  • Keep quality high together: Collaborate with teams across the company to improve documentation based on priorities and real-world feedback.

Why you'll love this role

  • Learn by doing: You’ll build deep product knowledge and explore the ecommerce industry with the support of experienced colleagues.
  • Get close to the tech: You’ll work side by side with engineers and the product, learning how our APIs, integrations, and developer tools fit together.

  • Consulting-like experience: You’ll work with several teams, grow your influence, and sharpen your problem-solving and structuring skills as you turn complex technical concepts into clear, user-friendly guidance.

  • Practical AI user: You already use LLMs in your day-to-day work and have a feel for where they help and where they don’t.

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters

The Customer Registration Manager is a critical operational role within the Customer Success organisation, working closely with Technical Account Managers (TAMs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to streamline and own all customer registration processes end-to-end. This individual will serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring customers are accurately registered, onboarded to relevant platforms, and tracked throughout the registration lifecycle — freeing up TAMs and CSMs to focus on strategic relationship management and value delivery.

Your key responsibilities

Registration Processing & Management

  • Own the end-to-end processing of all customer registration requests across platforms, tools, and internal systems.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for registration-related queries from TAMs, CSMs, and customers.
  • Ensure all customer data is accurately captured, validated, and maintained in relevant CRM and registration systems.
  • Manage and prioritise a queue of registration requests, ensuring timely completion against agreed SLAs.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (e.g. Legal, Finance, Compliance, Product) to resolve blockers or dependencies within the registration workflow.

Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date tracking of all in-flight and completed registration activities.
  • Build and maintain dashboards or reports to provide TAMs, CSMs, and management with real-time visibility into registration status.
  • Proactively flag at-risk or delayed registrations and drive resolution.
  • Produce regular reporting on registration volumes, completion rates, SLA adherence, and identified bottlenecks.

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in existing registration workflows and propose improvements to reduce manual effort and processing time.
  • Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all registration processes.
  • Partner with the Customer Success leadership team to implement scalable, repeatable registration frameworks as the customer base grows.
  • Support tooling and systems enhancements that improve registration accuracy and speed.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with TAMs and CSMs to gather registration requirements for new and existing customers.
  • Liaise with Product, Technical Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure registration processes meet regulatory and product requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Carrier, Regulatory, Numbers, and Operations teams to facilitate smooth processing of registration requests and resolve any carrier or regulatory dependencies.
  • Support onboarding activities where customer registration is a dependency for go-live.
  • Contribute to broader Customer Success initiatives and operational projects as required.

What you'll bring

Required:

  • 3+ years of experience in an operations, customer success, or registration/onboarding management role — ideally within a SaaS, CPaaS, or technology environment.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce) and project/task tracking platforms (e.g. Jira, Asana, or equivalent).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — able to work effectively across teams and escalate issues clearly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a passion for process improvement.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Experience working alongside TAM or CSM teams in a supporting operational capacity.
  • Familiarity with telecommunications, API, or communications platform products.
  • Experience building reporting and tracking in tools such as Google Sheets, Excel, or business intelligence platforms (e.g. Tableau, Looker).
  • Knowledge of compliance or regulatory registration requirements (e.g. 10DLC, toll-free verification, or regional number porting).

How you’ll benefit:

  • Discretionary Time Off
  • Private Medical Healthcare
  • Pension scheme
  • Ericsson support line

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled Research Scientist/Engineer to advance the reasoning and planning capabilities of large foundation models. In this role, you will enhance model performance across the entire development lifecycle—including data acquisition, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward modelling, and reinforcement learning—while driving innovations in reasoning and decision-making. You will synthesise large-scale, high-quality datasets through rewriting, augmentation, and generation techniques to strengthen foundation models during pretraining, SFT, and RL stages. A key part of the role involves solving complex tasks using System 2 thinking and applying advanced decoding strategies such as MCTS and A*. You will design and implement robust evaluation methodologies, teach models to interact with external tools, APIs, and code interpreters, and build agents and multi-agent systems capable of addressing sophisticated real-world problems.

Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize data processing and retrieval pipelines for enterprise-level generative tasks and mode training applications (Customer Service, Token Report, Web3 Domain Models). This includes embedding, reranking, context engineering, and query rewriting models.
  • Research and evaluate advanced AI-native retrieval algorithms (e.g., low-latency, multimodal retrieval, hierarchical retrieval, GraphRAG) to strengthen large-scale LLM/VLM/Agentic AI capabilities in Binance products.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to integrate RAG pipelines into production systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and measurable business impact.
  • Develop and optimize retrieval and ranking pipelines (indexing, vector search, retrieval scoring, reranking) to improve user experience.
  • Participate in LLM training and RAG system, staying current with techniques such as pre-training, SFT, and reinforcement learning, and apply them to retrieval and generation tasks.
  • Apply NLP, CV, and multimodal methods to analyze user-generated content (classification, quality evaluation, trend detection, comment analysis).

Requirement

  • Master’s in Information Retrieval, NLP, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Multimodal Learning, or related fields.
  • Proficient in PyTorch with strong coding skills in Python or C++.
  • Strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and passion for lifelong learning. Able to identify opportunities and drive cutting-edge retrieval & RAG technologies into real-world applications.
  • Solid theoretical foundation in information retrieval, NLP, and deep learning (experience with embeddings, reranking, query understanding preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, vector databases, multimodal/graph retrieval, or large-scale AI systems.
  • Strong engineering ability to translate research into scalable, production-level systems.
  • Self-driven, able to own projects end-to-end (design → implementation → deployment).
  • Publications in top-tier conferences/journals (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR, SIGIR, KDD, WWW) are a plus; awards in ACM/ICPC or similar competitions preferred.
